issues.detail: The Hebrew phrase 'לֹא כֵן בַּדָּיו' (lo ken badav) is rendered as '都並非如此獨自' (all not so alone), which is unclear and likely mistranslates 'בַּדָּיו' (his boasts/empty talk). The Hebrew means 'not so his boasts' or 'his boasts are not so' — i.e., his boasting is not justified. The Chinese adds '獨自' (alone) which has no basis in the Hebrew and changes the meaning.
